   395→def _cmd_stage_reflect(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   396→    """Record the REFLECT stage: compare current findings against completed work.
   397→
   398→    Forces the agent to consider what was previously resolved and whether
   399→    similar issues are recurring. Requires a 100-char report (50 if ≤3 findings).
   400→    If recurring patterns are detected, the report must mention at least one
   401→    recurring dimension name.
   402→    """
   403→    report: str | None = getattr(args, "report", None)
   404→    attestation: str | None = getattr(args, "attestation", None)
   405→
   406→    runtime = command_runtime(args)
   407→    state = runtime.state
   408→    plan = load_plan()
   409→
   410→    if SYNTHESIS_ID not in plan.get("queue_order", []):
   411→        print(colorize("  synthesis::pending is not in the queue — nothing to reflect on.", "yellow"))
   412→        return
   413→
   414→    meta = plan.get("epic_synthesis_meta", {})
   415→    stages = meta.get("synthesis_stages", {})
   416→
   417→    # Jump-back: reuse existing report if no --report provided
   418→    existing_stage = stages.get("reflect")
   419→    is_reuse = False
   420→    if not report and existing_stage and existing_stage.get("report"):
   421→        report = existing_stage["report"]
   422→        is_reuse = True
   423→    elif not report:
   424→        print(colorize("  --report is required for --stage reflect.", "red"))
   425→        print(colorize("  Compare current findings against completed work and form a holistic strategy:", "dim"))
   426→        print(colorize("  - What clusters were previously completed? Did fixes hold?", "dim"))
   427→        print(colorize("  - Are any dimensions recurring (resolved before, open again)?", "dim"))
   428→        print(colorize("  - What contradictions did you find? Which direction will you take?", "dim"))
   429→        print(colorize("  - Big picture: what to prioritize, what to defer, what to skip?", "dim"))
   430→        return
   431→
   432→    if "observe" not in stages:
   433→        print(colorize("  Cannot reflect: observe stage not complete.", "red"))
   434→        print(colorize('  Run: desloppify plan synthesize --stage observe --report "..."', "dim"))
   435→        return
   436→
   437→    si = collect_synthesis_input(plan, state)
   438→
   439→    # Fold-confirm: auto-confirm observe if attestation provided
   440→    if not stages["observe"].get("confirmed_at"):
   441→        if attestation and len(attestation.strip()) >= _MIN_ATTESTATION_LEN:
   442→            _by_dim, dim_names = _observe_dimension_breakdown(si)
   443→            validation_err = _validate_attestation(attestation.strip(), "observe", dimensions=dim_names)
   444→            if validation_err:
   445→                print(colorize(f"  {validation_err}", "red"))
   446→                return
   447→            stages["observe"]["confirmed_at"] = utc_now()
   448→            stages["observe"]["confirmed_text"] = attestation.strip()
   449→            save_plan(plan)
   450→            print(colorize("  \u2713 Observe auto-confirmed via --attestation.", "green"))
   451→        else:
   452→            print(colorize("  Cannot reflect: observe stage not confirmed.", "red"))
   453→            print(colorize("  Run: desloppify plan synthesize --confirm observe", "dim"))
   454→            print(colorize("  Or pass --attestation to auto-confirm observe inline.", "dim"))
   455→            return
   456→
   457→    finding_count = len(si.open_findings)
   458→
   459→    # Validation: report length
   460→    min_chars = 50 if finding_count <= 3 else 100
   461→    if len(report) < min_chars:
   462→        print(colorize(f"  Report too short: {len(report)} chars (minimum {min_chars}).", "red"))
   463→        print(colorize("  Describe how current findings relate to previously completed work.", "dim"))
   464→        return
   465→
   466→    # Detect recurring patterns
   467→    recurring = detect_recurring_patterns(si.open_findings, si.resolved_findings)
   468→    recurring_dims = sorted(recurring.keys())
   469→
   470→    # If recurring patterns exist, report must mention at least one dimension
   471→    if recurring_dims:
   472→        report_lower = report.lower()
   473→        mentioned = [dim for dim in recurring_dims if dim.lower() in report_lower]
   474→        if not mentioned:
   475→            print(colorize("  Recurring patterns detected but not addressed in report:", "red"))
   476→            for dim in recurring_dims:
   477→                info = recurring[dim]
   478→                print(colorize(
   479→                    f"    {dim}: {len(info['resolved'])} resolved, "
   480→                    f"{len(info['open'])} still open — potential loop",
   481→                    "yellow",
   482→                ))
   483→            print(colorize(
   484→                "  Your report must mention at least one recurring dimension name.",
   485→                "dim",
   486→            ))
   487→            return
   488→
   489→    # Save stage
   490→    stages = meta.setdefault("synthesis_stages", {})
   491→    stages["reflect"] = {
   492→        "stage": "reflect",
   493→        "report": report,
   494→        "cited_ids": [],
   495→        "timestamp": utc_now(),
   496→        "finding_count": finding_count,
   497→        "recurring_dimensions": recurring_dims,
   498→    }
   499→

   761→def _cmd_synthesize_complete(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   762→    """Complete synthesis \u2014 requires organize stage (or confirm-existing path)."""
   763→    strategy: str | None = getattr(args, "strategy", None)
   764→    attestation: str | None = getattr(args, "attestation", None)
   765→    plan = load_plan()

   768→        print(colorize("  synthesis::pending is not in the queue \u2014 nothing to complete.", "yellow"))

   771→    meta = plan.get("epic_synthesis_meta", {})
   772→    stages = meta.get("synthesis_stages", {})
   773→
   774→    state = command_runtime(args).state
   775→    review_ids = _open_review_ids_from_state(state)
   776→
   777→    # Require organize stage confirmed
   778→    if "organize" not in stages:
   779→        if "observe" not in stages:
   780→            print(colorize("  Cannot complete: no stages done yet.", "red"))
   781→            print(colorize('  Start with: desloppify plan synthesize --stage observe --report "..."', "dim"))
   782→        else:

   784→            gaps = _unenriched_clusters(plan)
   785→            if gaps:
   786→                print(colorize(f"  {len(gaps)} cluster(s) still need enrichment:", "yellow"))
   787→                for name, missing in gaps:
   788→                    print(colorize(f"    {name}: missing {', '.join(missing)}", "yellow"))
   789→                print(colorize(

   793→                print(colorize(

   928→
   929→def _cmd_confirm_existing(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   930→    """Fast-track: confirm existing plan structure is still valid."""
   931→    note: str | None = getattr(args, "note", None)
   932→    strategy: str | None = getattr(args, "strategy", None)
   933→    confirmed: str | None = getattr(args, "confirmed", None)
   934→    plan = load_plan()
   935→
   936→    if SYNTHESIS_ID not in plan.get("queue_order", []):
   937→        print(colorize("  synthesis::pending is not in the queue — nothing to confirm.", "yellow"))
   938→        return
   939→
   940→    meta = plan.get("epic_synthesis_meta", {})
   941→    stages = meta.get("synthesis_stages", {})
   942→
   943→    # Require a prior completed synthesis — can't skip the full flow on first run
   944→    prior_strategy = meta.get("strategy_summary", "")
   945→    if not prior_strategy:
   946→        print(colorize("  Cannot confirm existing: no prior synthesis has been completed.", "red"))
   947→        print(colorize("  The full OBSERVE → REFLECT → ORGANIZE → COMMIT flow is required the first time.", "dim"))
   948→        print(colorize(f"  Create and enrich clusters, then: {SYNTH_CMD_ORGANIZE}", "dim"))
   949→        return
   950→
   951→    # Determine if this is a light-path (additions only) or full ceremony
   952→    runtime = command_runtime(args)
   953→    state = runtime.state
   954→    si = collect_synthesis_input(plan, state)
   955→    has_only_additions = bool(si.new_since_last) and not si.resolved_since_last
   956→
   957→    if not has_only_additions:
   958→        # Full ceremony: require observe + reflect
   959→        if "observe" not in stages:
   960→            print(colorize("  Cannot confirm existing: observe stage not complete.", "red"))
   961→            print(colorize("  You must read findings first.", "dim"))
   962→            print(colorize('  Run: desloppify plan synthesize --stage observe --report "..."', "dim"))
   963→            return
   964→        if "reflect" not in stages:
   965→            print(colorize("  Cannot confirm existing: reflect stage not complete.", "red"))
   966→            print(colorize("  You must compare against completed work first.", "dim"))
   967→            print(colorize('  Run: desloppify plan synthesize --stage reflect --report "..."', "dim"))
   968→            return
   969→    else:
   970→        # Light path: show new items for review, no prior stages needed
   971→        print(colorize(f"  {len(si.new_since_last)} new finding(s) since last synthesis:", "cyan"))
   972→        for fid in sorted(si.new_since_last):
   973→            f = si.open_findings.get(fid, {})
   974→            print(f"    * [{short_finding_id(fid)}] {f.get('summary', '')}")
   975→        print()
   976→
   977→    # Require existing enriched clusters
   978→    clusters_with_findings = _manual_clusters_with_findings(plan)
   979→    if not clusters_with_findings:
   980→        print(colorize("  Cannot confirm existing: no clusters with findings exist.", "red"))
   981→        print(colorize("  Use the full organize flow instead.", "dim"))
   982→        return
   983→
   984→    # Require note
   985→    if not note:
   986→        print(colorize("  --note is required for confirm-existing.", "red"))
   987→        print(colorize('  Explain why the existing plan is still valid (min 100 chars).', "dim"))
   988→        return
   989→    if len(note) < 100:
   990→        print(colorize(f"  Note too short: {len(note)} chars (minimum 100).", "red"))
   991→        return
   992→
   993→    # Require strategy (default to "same" on light path)
   994→    if not strategy:
   995→        if has_only_additions:
   996→            strategy = "same"
   997→        else:
   998→            print(colorize("  --strategy is required.", "red"))
   999→            existing = meta.get("strategy_summary", "")

## COMPREHENSIVE GATE PHASES, SYNTHESIS WORKFLOW & REVIEW CYCLE ARCHITECTURE

### 1. GATE PHASES - CORE LOGIC

**Location:** `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_work_queue/core.py` (lines 52-85)

**Gate Phase Function Signature:**
```python
def _derive_gate_phase(
    all_items: list[dict],
    plan: dict | None,
    *,
    has_objective_findings: bool,
) -> tuple[str | None, list[dict], bool]:
```

**Gate Phase State Machine:**
1. **"needs_review"** — Gate is ACTIVE
   - Returned when review items exist AND (initial OR no objective backlog)
   - Initial review (placeholder dimensions): always gates onboarding
   - Stale review (previously-scored, refresh needed): gates only when NO objective items remain
   - Sets `plan["pending_plan_gate"] = True` to mark review→plan transition point

2. **"needs_plan"** — Gate is ACTIVE (post-review)
   - Returned when `plan.pending_plan_gate` is True AND no review items remain
   - Blocks queue until user runs `desloppify plan`
   - Clears `pending_plan_gate` in `cmd.py:_cmd_plan_generate()` (line 28)

3. **None** — Gate is INACTIVE
   - No gating; normal queue flow
   - Both review gates passed

**Key Logic (lines 66-85):**
- Review items identified: `initial_review` or `stale_review` flags in item dict
- Initial review always triggers gate (onboarding)
- Stale review only gates when objective backlog is empty
- `plan_dirty` flag signals that plan was mutated (pending_plan_gate set)

**Gate Bypass:**
- Scoped queries (`--scope`) or cluster focus skip gating entirely (line 413)
- Allows drilling into gated items without unlocking full queue

    """Inject synthesis::pending when review findings snapshot hash changes."""

**Hash Comparison Logic (lines 318-324):**
- Current hash: SHA256 of sorted open review/concerns IDs (last 16 chars)
- Last hash: stored in `plan.epic_synthesis_meta.finding_snapshot_hash`
- Injects `SYNTHESIS_ID` ("synthesis::pending") after promoted items when:

**Never auto-prunes** — only explicit completion removes it.

**Synthesis Four-Stage Workflow:**

Stages stored in `plan.epic_synthesis_meta.synthesis_stages`:
1. **OBSERVE** (lines 47 in synthesize_handlers)

2. **REFLECT**

   - Detect recurring patterns via `detect_recurring_patterns()` (epic_synthesis.py:81-115)
   - Marks which dimensions have both open and resolved findings (loops)

3. **ORGANIZE**
   - Structural: create/refine clusters for review findings
   - Gate: non-auto clusters must have `description` + `action_steps`
   - `_unenriched_clusters()` checks for missing enrichment (line 124-143)

4. **COMMIT** (not shown but implicit)
   - Strategy confirmation

   - Updates `epic_synthesis_meta.finding_snapshot_hash` on completion

**Cascade Clear (lines 50-62):**
- When user re-edits an earlier stage, clears confirmations on all later stages
- Prevents stale subsequent confirmations

### 4. ITEM INJECTION PIPELINE & RANKING

**Build Sequence (work_queue/core.py:333-449):**

1. **Base Finding Items** (lines 350-356)
   - `build_finding_items()` → mechanical findings with status filter
   - Has `is_review`, `is_subjective` flags; subjective score; primary_command

2. **Subjective Items** (lines 361-380)
   - Added if `include_subjective=True` AND status in {open, all} AND not chronic
   - Filtered by threshold (`subjective_threshold`)
   - `backlog_gated` items suppressed if objective backlog exists

3. **Synthesis Item** (lines 382-386)
   - Injected ONLY if `SYNTHESIS_ID` in `plan.queue_order`
   - Via `build_synthesis_item(plan, state)` → returns dict with `kind: "synthesis_needed"`
   - Always Tier 1 (highest priority)

4. **Initial Rank Sort** (line 388)
   - `all_items.sort(key=item_sort_key)`

5. **Plan Reordering** (lines 391-400)
   - `_apply_plan_order()` if plan provided
   - Respects `queue_order`, `new_ids` (from latest scan), `skipped`
   - Annotates items with plan metadata: `plan_description`, `plan_cluster`, `plan_note`

6. **Auto-Cluster Collapse** (lines 402-410)
   - Replaces cluster members with single meta-item if `collapse_clusters=True`
   - Preserves sorting; meta-item has `kind: "cluster"`

7. **Gate Phase Filter** (lines 412-421)
   - Applies `_derive_gate_phase()` UNLESS scoped/cluster filtered
   - Returns `gate_phase` + filtered items (or all_items if no gate)
   - Can set `plan_dirty = True` (pending_plan_gate mutation)

8. **Subjective Interleave Guard** (lines 423-431)
   - Interleaves subjective/objective to prevent starvation
   - Default: 3 objective items per 1 subjective item

9. **Count & Return** (lines 433-449)
   - Final count; return WorkQueueResult with gate_phase + plan_dirty

**Ranking Key (ranking.py:81-117):**

Sort order (lowest tuple first):
```
synthesis_needed:    (-1, 0, 0, id)                    # ALWAYS FIRST
cluster:             (0, action_type_priority, -count, id)
subjective:          (1, 1, strict_score, id)          # AFTER mechanical
mechanical/review:   (1, 0, confidence, -review_weight, -count, id)
```

### 5. RECONCILIATION & GATE CLEARING

**Post-Scan Reconciliation:**

Location: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_plan/reconcile.py` (lines 132-218)

```python
def reconcile_plan_after_scan(plan, state) -> ReconcileResult:
    """Reconcile plan against current state after scan."""
```

**What happens (lines 146-186):**
1. Collects all referenced IDs (queue_order, skipped, overrides, clusters)
2. Excludes already-superseded + synthetic IDs (SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX, SYNTHESIS_ID)
3. Checks if each ID still exists and is open
4. Moves dead IDs to `superseded` dict with context (candidates for remapping)
5. Removes dead IDs from all structures (queue_order, skipped, cluster membership)
6. Reconciles epic clusters: removes dead findings, deletes empty epics
7. Resurfaces temporary skips past `review_after` threshold (line 192)
8. Prunes superseded entries >90 days old (line 198)
9. Logs all changes to execution_log

**No direct gate manipulation** — gates are computed fresh each time via `_derive_gate_phase()`.

**When Gates Get Cleared:**

1. **Review→Plan Transition:** `plan.pending_plan_gate = False` in `cmd.py:_cmd_plan_generate()` (line 29)
   - Happens when user runs `desloppify plan` command
   - Allows queue to unlock and show objective items

2. **After Plan Command Completes:** Queue is re-queried; no more review items → gate drops to None

## SUMMARY FOR MIGRATION

To migrate to a **unified queue system**, key contracts to preserve:

1. **Gate mechanism** must run AFTER all items collected, BEFORE final ranking
2. **Synthetic items** (subjective, synthesis) must be ephemeral — regenerated per build
3. **Cascade clear** logic for synthesis stages when earlier stages re-edited
4. **Hash-based synthesis trigger** tied to review finding snapshot changes
5. **Backlog-gated suppression** of review-only items while objective work exists
6. **Promoted-item barrier** for unscored + stale dimension injection
7. **Reconciliation** must happen before any dimension sync
8. **pending_plan_gate flag** as single gate state marker (review→plan transition)

All ranking, interleaving, clustering, and filtering happens **within** the queue build, making it amenable to unified treatment.

## Complete User-Facing Flow Documentation

Based on my thorough exploration of the codebase, here is the **exact user-facing flow** for synthesis, review, and scan workflows:

---

### **1. SYNTHESIS FLOW — Exact User Commands**

The synthesis system uses a 4-stage workflow: **OBSERVE → REFLECT → ORGANIZE → COMMIT** with a fast-track **CONFIRM-EXISTING** skip path.

**Synthesis enters the queue as `synthesis::pending`:**
- Auto-injected when first running `--stage observe` (if not already in queue)
- Auto-injected by `sync_synthesis_needed()` when review finding snapshot hash changes
- Never auto-pruned—only explicit completion removes it
- T1 priority tier

#### **Stage 1: OBSERVE**
```bash
desloppify plan synthesize --stage observe --report "analysis of themes and root causes..."
```
- **Validation**: Report must be 50+ chars (≤3 findings) or 100+ chars (4+ findings)
- **No citation gate** — just requires genuine analysis, not ID-stuffing
- **Auto-start**: Injects `synthesis::pending` if not present
- **Jump-back**: Reuses existing report if no `--report` provided (preserves confirmation if it existed)
- **Output**: Stores in `plan.epic_synthesis_meta.synthesis_stages.observe`

#### **Stage 2: REFLECT** 
```bash
desloppify plan synthesize --stage reflect --report "comparison against completed work..."
```
- **Prerequisites**: Must have `observe` stage complete
- **Validation**: Report must be 50+ or 100+ chars; if recurring patterns detected, report MUST mention at least one recurring dimension name
- **Fold-confirm**: Can pass `--attestation` (80+ chars min) to auto-confirm `observe` inline
- **Recurring patterns detection**: Compares open findings against previously resolved ones
- **Output**: Stores in `synthesis_stages.reflect` + recurring dimension list

#### **Stage 3: ORGANIZE**
```bash
desloppify plan cluster create <name> --description "..."
desloppify plan cluster add <name> <finding-patterns>
desloppify plan cluster update <name> --description "..." --steps "step 1" "step 2"
desloppify plan synthesize --stage organize --report "summary of organization..."
```
- **Prerequisites**: Must have `reflect` stage complete
- **Structural validation**: Each manual (non-auto) cluster MUST have:
  - `description` (text)
  - `action_steps` (list of at least 1 step)
- **Report validation**: Must be 100+ chars minimum
- **Fold-confirm**: Can auto-confirm `reflect` if `--attestation` provided (80+ chars)
- **Output**: Stores in `synthesis_stages.organize`

#### **Stage 4: COMMIT/COMPLETE**
```bash
desloppify plan synthesize --complete --strategy "execution plan describing priorities..."
```
- **Prerequisites**: Must have `organize` stage confirmed
- **Validation**: 
  - `--strategy` required (200+ chars OR special value "same" to reuse prior strategy)
  - Re-validates cluster enrichment at completion time
  - Checks that clusters exist and have findings
- **Fold-confirm**: Can auto-confirm `organize` if `--attestation` provided
- **On completion**:
  - Removes `synthesis::pending` from queue
  - Clears `synthesis_stages` dict (archives to `last_synthesis`)
  - Records `finding_snapshot_hash` (hash of open review finding IDs)
  - Records `synthesized_ids` (list of open review IDs at completion)
  - Stores `strategy_summary`
  - Records `last_completed_at` timestamp
  - Appends `execution_log` entry

#### **Fast-track: CONFIRM-EXISTING** (skip full flow)
```bash
desloppify plan synthesize --confirm-existing \
  --note "why plan is still valid..." \
  --strategy "same" \
  --confirmed "I validate this plan..."
```
- **Prerequisites**: Prior synthesis must have completed (must have `strategy_summary` in meta)
- **Auto-path (light)**: If only additions since last synthesis (no resolved findings):
  - Skips `observe` + `reflect` requirement
  - Shows new findings for review
  - Defaults `--strategy` to "same"
- **Mixed-path (full)**: If findings resolved AND new findings added:
  - Requires `observe` + `reflect` stages
- **Validations**:
  - `--note` must be 100+ chars minimum
  - `--confirmed` must be 80+ chars minimum
  - If new findings exist, `--note` must cite at least 1 new finding ID
  - Must have enriched clusters (same rules as full path)

#### **Confirmation Workflow** (attestation gates each stage)
```bash
desloppify plan synthesize --confirm observe --attestation "I have reviewed..."
desloppify plan synthesize --confirm reflect --attestation "I have reviewed..."  
desloppify plan synthesize --confirm organize --attestation "I have reviewed..."
```
- **Flow**: Each stage must be confirmed before next stage can proceed
- **Attestation**: 80+ chars minimum; must reference:
  - OBSERVE: at least one dimension name
  - REFLECT: at least one dimension OR cluster name
  - ORGANIZE: at least one cluster name
- **Cascade clear**: When re-recording a stage, all confirmations on later stages are cleared
- **Jump-back**: Can re-record earlier stages; report reused if no `--report` provided

#### **Manual Start (Override)**
```bash
desloppify plan synthesize --start
```
- Injects `synthesis::pending` at front of queue
- Clears any existing stages (fresh start)
- Useful for restarting synthesis from scratch

#### **Dashboard View (No args)**
```bash
desloppify plan synthesize
```
- Shows current synthesis state
- Displays findings by dimension
- Shows stage progress with enrichment gaps
- Shows next command guidance based on current state
- Highlights contradictions and recurring patterns

### **2. REVIEW FLOW — Exact User Commands**

#### **Import Review Findings**
```bash
desloppify review import <json-file>
desloppify review import <json-file> --validate-import  # Dry-run
```
- **Assessment modes** (auto-detected from payload):
  - **holistic**: Standard review findings + optional assessments
  - **manual_override**: Manual dimensional assessments (provisional until next scan)
  - **trusted_internal**: Attestation-verified assessments
  - **attested_external**: External review source with attestation
- **Flag combinations**:
  - `--manual-override --attest "reason..."` — marks assessments provisional
  - `--attested-external` — trusts external source
  - `--allow-partial` — allows import with validation errors
- **On success**:
  - Syncs plan: new/reopened findings added to queue
  - Shows plan update message
  - Prints score changes + subjective dimension status
  - Outputs `query.json` with import metadata

#### **Assessment Handling**
- **Manual overrides** stored as `provisional_override=True`
- **Expire at scan start** → reset to `score=0.0`, marked `manual_override_expired`
- **Trusted assessments** clear provisional flags
- **Audit trail** stored in `assessment_import_audit` array

#### **Plan Sync on Review Import**
- Detects new/reopened findings from review
- Appends to `queue_order` at end (preserves plan order)
- Injects `synthesis::pending` if review findings changed
- Logs `review_import_sync` entry in execution log

---

### **3. SCAN WORKFLOW INTEGRATION — Exact Gates & Hooks**

```bash
desloppify scan [--path <path>] [--lang python|typescript]
desloppify scan --reset-subjective  # Reset all subjective assessments to 0
```

#### **Scan → Plan Reconciliation (post-scan)**

After findings merge, reconciliation runs automatically:

1. **Plan reconciliation** (`reconcile_plan_after_scan`):
   - Re-surfaces skipped items after review period expires
   - Removes superseded items (findings that disappeared)

2. **Unscored dimensions sync** (`sync_unscored_dimensions`):
   - Prepends unscored (placeholder) subjective dimensions to FRONT of queue
   - Unconditional—initial reviews are first priority

3. **Stale dimensions sync** (`sync_stale_dimensions`):
   - Appends stale (previously-scored) dimensions to BACK of queue
   - Only when NO objective items remain
   - Prevents burying subjective work in active objective queue

4. **Auto-clustering** (`auto_cluster_findings`):
   - Regenerates automatic task clusters if target strict score not met
   - Uses dimension grouping + heuristics

5. **Synthesis sync** (`sync_synthesis_needed`):
   - Injects `synthesis::pending` if review finding snapshot hash changed
   - Never auto-prunes (only explicit completion removes it)
   - Detects new/resolved review findings via hash

6. **Plan-start score freeze** (`seed_plan_start_scores`):
   - On first queue item, records `plan_start_scores` (strict, overall, objective, verified)
   - Score frozen during queue execution
   - Cleared when queue drains

#### **Subjective Assessment Reset**
- `--reset-subjective` flag resets known dimensions to `score=0.0, placeholder=True`
- Uses `resettable_default_dimensions(lang_name)` for canonical list
- Applied at scan start before any processing

#### **Provisional Manual Override Expiry**
- At scan start, checks `provisional_override=True` items
- Expires them: `score=0.0, source="manual_override_expired", placeholder=True`
- Forces re-assessment via normal review pathway

#### **Plan gates from scan**
- `pending_plan_gate` cleared when `plan` is generated
- Allows queue to unlock after `plan` command runs
- Best-effort (exceptions suppressed, doesn't break scan)

### **8. GUARDRAILS & GATES**

**Synthesis staleness gate** (`require_synthesis_current_or_exit`):
- Blocks commands if synthesis stale (new review findings not triaged)
- Used by: `resolve`, `fix`, `status` (certain contexts)
- Can bypass with `--force-resolve --attest "I understand..."`
- Shows new IDs blocking the command

**Review-to-plan gate** (`pending_plan_gate`):
- Set by review import if findings changed
- Cleared by `plan` command
- Prevents queue execution until plan explicitly generated

**Queue drained gate** (`clear_plan_start_scores_if_queue_empty`):
- Clears `plan_start_scores` when all items resolved
- Reveals score improvement at completion

### **9. TEST EXPECTATIONS** (from test files)

Key behaviors verified:

1. **Auto-start synthesis** — `--stage observe` injects `synthesis::pending` if absent
2. **Cascade clear** — Confirming an earlier stage clears later confirmations  
3. **Jump-back** — Re-running a stage reuses report if not provided
4. **Fold-confirm** — `--attestation` can auto-confirm prior stage inline
5. **Recurring dimension check** — Reflect report must mention recurring dims
6. **Cluster enrichment** — Organize gated on manual clusters having description + steps
7. **Coverage tracking** — Synthesis coverage computed from manual clusters + open findings
8. **Snapshot hash** — Detects review finding changes; injects synthesis on change
9. **Confirmed-existing** — Light path for additions only; full path for mixed changes
10. **Artifact archival** — Stages archived to `last_synthesis` on completion

## Summary: Queue Item Rendering, Resolution, and Consumption Flow in Desloppify

I've thoroughly read through all the key files you specified. Here's a comprehensive deep-dive covering how queue items flow through the system:

---

### **1. ITEM RENDERING IN NEXT COMMAND**

#### **File: `next.py` (entry point)**
- **Flow**: `cmd_next()` → `_get_items()` → `build_work_queue()` → `render_terminal_items()`
- **Key context builders**:
  - Loads living plan via `load_plan()` (determines plan-aware rendering)
  - Builds queue with `QueueBuildOptions` including: count, scope, status, include_subjective, plan, cluster focus
  - Extracts plan-start frozen score and queue breakdown for lifecycle display
  - Computes narrative via `compute_narrative()` for strategic coaching
  
- **Gate phase handling**: 
  - Calls `render_gate_banner()` which gates queue display when in review/plan cycle
  - If gated, shows only review items and returns early (no followup nudges)
  - Skips frozen score display to avoid conflicting messages

#### **File: `next_parts/render.py` (terminal rendering)**
- **Item-specific renderers**:
  - **Clusters**: `_render_cluster_item()` — shows member count, file distribution, representatives, action command, resolution hints (skip/drill-in/resolve-all)
  - **Synthesis items**: Compact T1 blocker card showing review count, changes since last synthesis
  - **Regular findings**: Confidence badge, file/ID/lines, detail (category, importers, suggestion), code snippet, dimension context
  - **Subjective dimensions**: Shows score, dimension name, action (re-review), note about score volatility

- **Plan overrides surface**:
  - Description (cyan arrow), cluster membership (with total), notes (gray)
  - Annotations come from `item["plan_description"]`, `item["plan_cluster"]`, `item["plan_note"]`

- **Impact estimation** (when potentials available):
  - Calls `compute_score_impact()` to estimate points gained by fixing this item
  - Shows dimension drag for review findings (cost to overall score)

- **Explain mode** (`--explain`):
  - Renders confidence rank, count weight, dimension context, subjective score, policy reason

#### **File: `next_parts/output.py` (JSON/markdown output)**
- **Query payload structure**:
  ```python
  {
    "command": "next",
    "items": [serialized_items],
    "queue": {"total", "suppressed_count", "gate_phase"},
    "scorecard_dimensions": [...],
    "subjective_measures": [...],
    "narrative": {...},
    "plan": {
      "active": True,
      "focus": active_cluster_name,
      "clusters": [summary_objects],
      "total_ordered": count,
      "total_skipped": count,
    }
  }
  ```
- **Item serialization** (`serialize_item()`):
  - Cluster meta-items get `kind="cluster"`, `members`, `member_count`, `primary_command`
  - Regular findings get all finding fields plus plan metadata (queue_position, plan_description, plan_cluster, plan_skipped, plan_skip_kind, plan_skip_reason)
- **Output modes**: Terminal (rich), JSON, Markdown

---

### **2. SHOW COMMAND**

#### **File: `show/cmd.py` (dispatcher)**
- **Entity resolution** (`resolve_entity()`):
  1. Check special views: "concerns", "subjective", "subjective_review"
  2. Check mechanical dimensions (from scoring.DIMENSIONS registry)
  3. Check subjective dimensions (from scoring.DISPLAY_NAMES or dimension_scores)
  4. Fallback to file_or_pattern
  
- **Dispatch paths**:
  - **Concerns**: `_show_concerns()` — renders design concerns with evidence
  - **Subjective dimension**: `_render_subjective_dimension()` — shows score + review-based explanation + open review findings
  - **Mechanical dimension**: `_load_dimension_findings()` — aggregates all findings for detectors in dimension
  - **File/pattern**: `load_matches()` → scoped queue via work_queue builder

- **Noise budget application**:
  - `resolve_noise()` applies detector/global budgets (hidable findings)
  - Renders top N files by finding count (default 20)

#### **File: `show/render.py`**
- **Grouped rendering** (`render_findings()`):
  - Groups findings by file
  - For each file: sorts by tier then confidence, shows icon, summary, detail parts
  - Optional code snippet display
  - Reopen warning (2+ reopens)
  - Rollup summary (by detector, by tier)

- **Plan integration** (`show_agent_plan()`):
  - When living plan active: shows cluster focus progress instead of narrative actions
  - Otherwise: shows top narrative action with ranked follow-up actions

- **Subjective followup**: Calls `show_subjective_followup()` from render.py

#### **File: `show/scope.py` (matching & querying)**
- **`load_matches()`**: Builds work queue with status filter, returns only findings (filters out clusters/subjective items)
- **Scope matching** (in helpers.py):
  - Wildcard patterns: `fnmatch()` against id/file/detector/summary/dimension
  - `::` prefix: Finding ID prefix match
  - Hash suffix: 8+ hex chars match tail of ID
  - Else: Detector name, filepath, or path prefix

---

### **3. STATUS COMMAND**

#### **File: `status_cmd.py` (orchestrator)**
- **Lightweight gate phase** (count=0 queue):
  - Builds minimal queue just to derive gate phase
  - Calls `render_gate_banner()` if gated
  
- **Frozen score context**:
  - `get_plan_start_strict()` from plan metadata
  - `plan_aware_queue_breakdown()` counts queue items
  - Shows frozen plan-start → live estimate with delta when in active cycle

- **Scorecard display**:
  - Calls `show_dimension_table()` with dimension_scores
  - Shows dimension health/strict scores, issue counts, action types
  - Separates objective (detector-based) and subjective (review-based) rows

#### **File: `status_parts/render.py` (display helpers)**
- **Dimension table**:
  - `_render_objective_dimensions()`: Loops through DIMENSIONS, shows bars, highlights lowest (yellow arrow)
  - `_render_subjective_dimensions()`: Shows scorecard subjective entries with stale/unassessed tags, open issue counts
  - Counts open review findings per dimension via `_open_review_issue_counts()`

- **Focus suggestion** (`show_focus_suggestion()`):
  - If plan has active_cluster: shows cluster focus + remaining items
  - Else: shows lowest dimension + estimated impact of fixing all issues

- **Structural areas** (`show_structural_areas()`):
  - Groups T3/T4 structural findings by area
  - Shows area summary table with tier breakdown
  - Suggests task doc workflow for decomposition

- **Query write** (`write_status_query()`):
  - Payload includes next_command (from narrative.actions[0])
  - Plan summary (focus, cluster count, queue size)

---

### **4. RESOLVE MECHANISMS**

#### **File: `resolve/cmd.py` (main resolver)**
- **Preflight checks**:
  - Queue order guard: if living plan exists, ensures resolved IDs are at front of queue
  - Synthesis guardrail: blocks `fixed` status when new findings pending (unless --force-resolve or attestation)
  - Note length validation (≥50 chars for fixed)
  - Attestation validation (contains "I have actually" + "not gaming")

- **Score snapshot capture** before/after:
  - Captures prev subjective_assessments scores for hint rendering

- **Plan cleanup** (post-resolve):
  - Calls `purge_ids(plan, all_resolved)` to remove from queue
  - Logs action to execution_log
  - Saves plan if purged

- **Output sequence**:
  1. Resolve summary (count, status)
  2. Wontfix batch warning
  3. Score with plan context
  4. Subjective reset hint (if subjective scores changed)
  5. Narrative milestone message
  6. Query entry

#### **File: `resolve/selection.py` (validation)**
- **Batch wontfix confirmation**:
  - If >10 findings being wontfixed: requires `--confirm-batch-wontfix`
  - Estimates strict-score delta via preview resolve
  - Warns about debt added

- **Attestation keywords**: "I have actually" + "not gaming" (case-insensitive, flexible spacing)
- **Note length**: Minimum 50 chars

---

### **5. WORK QUEUE BUILDING**

#### **File: `_work_queue/core.py` (main builder)**

**QueueBuildOptions dataclass**:
```python
count: int | None = 1
scope: str | None = None
status: str = "open"
include_subjective: bool = True
subjective_threshold: float = 100.0
chronic: bool = False  # reopened 2+ times
explain: bool = False
plan: dict | None = None
include_skipped: bool = False
cluster: str | None = None
collapse_clusters: bool = True
```

**`build_work_queue()` sequence**:
1. **Build finding items**: `build_finding_items()` → scoped + filtered by status
2. **Add subjective items**: `build_subjective_items()` if include_subjective + open status
3. **Suppress backlog-gated subjective**: Skip if objective backlog exists + only action is rerun
4. **Inject synthesis item**: `build_synthesis_item()` if plan needs synthesis
5. **Sort by rank**: `item_sort_key()` 
6. **Apply plan order**: `_apply_plan_order()` — ordered items first, then remaining by recency
7. **Collapse clusters**: `_collapse_clusters()` — replace small groups with meta-items
8. **Gate phase derivation**: `_derive_gate_phase()` — "needs_review"/"needs_plan"/None
9. **Interleave subjective** (guardrail): 3 objective items per 1 subjective
10. **Limit count**: Slice to requested count

**Plan order logic**:
- Queue items in `plan.queue_order` appear first, in that order
- Remaining existing items keep mechanical sort
- New items (from latest scan) sort after existing
- Skipped items appended last (or excluded)
- Each item annotated with plan metadata: `plan_description`, `plan_note`, `plan_cluster`, `plan_skipped`, `queue_position`

**Clustering**:
- Auto-clusters (marked `auto: True`) collapsed into meta-items
- Singleton clusters shown as individual findings
- Meta-item summary uses stored description, patched count if visible differs from stored

#### **File: `_work_queue/ranking.py` (sort order)**

**`item_sort_key()` tuple**:
1. Synthesis items: `(-1, 0, 0, id)` — always first
2. Clusters: `(0, action_type_priority, -member_count, id)` — before findings
3. Subjective items: `(1, 1, subjective_score, id)` — after mechanical
4. Regular findings: `(1, 0, confidence_rank, -review_weight, -count, id)`

**Action type priority**: auto_fix=0, refactor=1, manual_fix=2, reorganize=3

**Confidence order**: From CONFIDENCE_ORDER dict (high < medium < low)

#### **File: `_work_queue/helpers.py` (item builders)**

**`build_finding_items()`**:
- Filters by: not suppressed, status match, chronic (2+ reopens), scope match
- Adds computed fields: `is_review`, `is_subjective`, `review_weight`, `subjective_score`, `primary_command`
- `review_weight`: high=1.0, medium=0.7, low=0.3; holistic ×10
- `primary_command`: For auto-fix detectors with supported fixers → `desloppify fix <fixer> --dry-run`; for subjective_review → review command; else → plan done command

**`build_subjective_items()`**:
- Creates synthetic work items from scorecard subjective entries (dimension scores)
- Filters by strict_score < threshold
- Each dimension becomes a `subjective_dimension` kind item with:
  - ID: `subjective::<slugified-key>`
  - Detail: dimension_name, dimension (key), issues, strict_score, open_review_findings
  - Primary command: review --prepare (optionally with dimensions/force-review-rerun)
  - Flags: initial_review (unassessed), stale_review, backlog_gated

**`build_synthesis_item()`**:
- If `synthesis::pending` in queue_order: builds synthetic T1 item
- Compares open review IDs vs last synthesized IDs to count new/resolved
- Summary: "Synthesize {count} review findings into coherent plan"

**`primary_command_for_finding()`**:
- If detector has auto_fix action + supported fixers available: `desloppify fix <fixer> --dry-run`
- Else if subjective_review + holistic: `desloppify review --prepare`
- Else if subjective_review: `desloppify show subjective`
- Else: `desloppify plan done "<id>" --note "<what>" --confirm`

---

### **6. PLAN OPERATIONS & SCHEMA**

#### **File: `_plan/schema.py` (data structures)**

**PlanModel TypedDict**:
- `queue_order: list[str]` — priority-ordered finding IDs
- `skipped: dict[str, SkipEntry]` — temporary/permanent/false_positive, with reason/note/attestation
- `overrides: dict[str, ItemOverride]` — description/note/cluster annotations per finding
- `clusters: dict[str, Cluster]` — manual + auto-generated groupings with members/action/description
- `active_cluster: str | None` — focused cluster
- `execution_log: list[ExecutionLogEntry]` — audit trail of mutations
- `plan_start_scores: dict` — frozen scorecard snapshot
- `pending_plan_gate: bool` — True when reviews done, plan not yet run
- `epic_synthesis_meta: dict` — synthesis stage tracking

**SkipEntry variants**:
- "temporary": resurface after N scans
- "permanent": wontfix (requires note + attestation)
- "false_positive": not a real issue (requires attestation)
- "synthesized_out": removed by synthesis

**Cluster**:
- `finding_ids: list[str]` — members
- `auto: bool` — True for auto-generated
- `action: str | None` — resolution command
- `user_modified: bool` — True if user edited membership

#### **File: `_plan/operations.py` (mutations)**

**Key operations**:
- `move_items(plan, finding_ids, position, target, offset)` — reorder queue
- `skip_items(plan, ids, kind, reason, note, attestation)` — add to skipped map
- `unskip_items(plan, ids)` — remove from skipped
- `describe_finding(plan, fid, text)` — set override.description
- `annotate_finding(plan, fid, text)` — set override.note
- `create_cluster(plan, name, description, finding_ids)` — new cluster
- `add_to_cluster(plan, cluster_name, finding_ids)` — add members
- `move_cluster(plan, cluster_name, position, ...)` — reorder cluster in queue
- `set_focus(plan, cluster_name)` — set active_cluster
- `purge_ids(plan, finding_ids)` — remove from queue_order + clusters
- `append_log_entry(plan, action, finding_ids, cluster_name, note, detail)` — audit log

#### **File: `plan.py` (public facade)**
- Re-exports schema (PlanModel, Cluster, etc.), persistence (load_plan, save_plan), operations, reconcile, auto-clustering, stale dimension sync
- `synthesis_phase_banner()` — renders banner for synthesis::pending

---

### **7. PLAN-SPECIFIC COMMAND HANDLERS**

#### **File: `plan/override_handlers.py` (done/skip/focus)**

**`cmd_plan_done(patterns, note, confirm, attest)`**:
- If `--confirm`: auto-generates attestation from note
- Validates note length + attestation
- **Cluster guard**: Blocks bulk-completing clusters with ≤10 items (forces individual resolution)
- Logs "done" action to execution_log
- Delegates to `cmd_resolve()` with status="fixed"
- This ensures resolve mechanisms (score snapshots, plan purge, synthesis triggers) apply

**`cmd_plan_skip(patterns, kind, reason, review_after, note, attest)`**:
- kind: "temporary" (default), "permanent" (--permanent), "false_positive" (--false-positive)
- Validates attestation for permanent/false_positive
- For permanent/false_positive: also calls `state_mod.resolve_findings()` to mark wontfix/false_positive in state
- Calls `skip_items()` to add to plan.skipped
- Logs "skip" action

**`cmd_plan_focus(cluster_name, clear)`**:
- Sets/clears `plan.active_cluster`
- When focused: subsequent `next` calls filter to cluster members
- Logs "focus" action

#### **File: `plan/cmd.py` (dispatcher)**
- `cmd_plan()` dispatches to:
  - Generate markdown plan (default) — runs `_cmd_plan_generate()` which clears pending_plan_gate
  - show, move, cluster subcommands
  - reset — clears queue_order, clusters, etc.

---

### **8. KEY DATA FLOW TOUCHPOINTS**

**When a finding is resolved** (`plan done` or `resolve`):
1. State: `state.findings[id].status` → "fixed" / "wontfix" / "false_positive"
2. Plan: `purge_ids()` removes from queue_order + all clusters
3. Execution log: Appends "done" or "resolve" entry
4. Query output: Updated via resolve command's `_write_resolve_query_entry()`

**When a finding is skipped**:
1. Plan: Added to `plan.skipped[id]` with kind + reason + attestation
2. State (permanent/false_positive): Also marks in findings
3. Queue: Skipped items shown last (or hidden if `include_skipped=False`)
4. Execution log: "skip" entry

**When items are reordered** (`plan move`):
1. Plan: `queue_order` list reordered
2. Queue: Next builds respect this order
3. New items: Sorted after existing remaining items
4. Execution log: "move" entry

**When items are clustered**:
1. Plan: `clusters[name].finding_ids` = members
2. Queue: If collapse_clusters=True and no drill-in, members replaced with meta-item
3. Meta-item sort: By action_type then member count
4. Execution log: "cluster" entry

---

### **9. ITEM LIFECYCLE SUMMARY**

```
FINDING (raw from state)
  ↓ build_finding_items()
QUEUE ITEM (with computed fields: is_review, is_subjective, primary_command)
  ↓ sort by item_sort_key()
  ↓ apply_plan_order() [if plan active]
  ↓ _collapse_clusters() [if plan active & not drilling]
DISPLAY ITEM (with plan metadata: queue_position, plan_cluster, plan_description, plan_note)
  ↓ render_item() [terminal] or serialize_item() [JSON]
RENDERED (rich terminal UI / JSON payload / Markdown)

RESOLUTION FLOW:
  user runs: plan done <id> / resolve <id> --status fixed
  → cmd_plan_done() / cmd_resolve()
  → state.findings[id].status = "fixed"
  → purge_ids(plan, [id])
  → append_log_entry("done" or "resolve")
  → save plan + state
  → next query omits this ID (not in state or marked complete)
```

---

### **10. CRITICAL INVARIANTS**

1. **Plan queue_order**: Source of truth for ordering when plan active; new items sort after existing remaining items
2. **Cluster collapse**: Only happens if `collapse_clusters=True` AND plan active AND no explicit drill-in
3. **Gate phases**: "needs_review" blocks queue until reviews done; "needs_plan" blocks until plan runs
4. **Skipped items**: Hidden by default unless `include_skipped=True`
5. **Synthesis item**: Injected into queue_order if present; has kind="synthesis_needed"
6. **Frozen scores**: Captured at plan creation; displayed alongside live estimates to show progress
7. **Plan purge**: Removes IDs from queue_order + all cluster.finding_ids when items resolved
8. **Execution log**: Immutable audit trail; capped at config value (default 10k entries)

This comprehensive system ensures:
- **Visibility**: Users see ranked, plan-aware queues with rich context
- **Directionality**: Plan enforces work sequence; queue order guard prevents skipping items
- **Auditability**: All mutations logged with actor/timestamp
- **Recovery**: Rollback snapshots on transactional failures; superseded tracking for remapped IDs

> DEVELOPER

I need to design a migration plan for unifying all workflow modes (review cycle, plan gate, synthesis stages, findings) into a single queue system in desloppify. The user wants "planning mode" (currently called synthesis) to just inject its 4 stages as queue items that flow through the same `next` → do → resolve → `next` loop as regular findings.

## Current Architecture

### Gate Phases (to be eliminated)
- `_derive_gate_phase()` in `_work_queue/core.py` returns "needs_review", "needs_plan", or None
- "needs_review": blocks queue, shows only review items (initial onboarding or stale end-of-cycle)
- "needs_plan": blocks queue entirely until `plan` command runs (set via `pending_plan_gate` boolean on plan)
- Gate logic runs AFTER all items collected but BEFORE final ranking
- `render_gate_banner()` in `next_parts/render.py` renders the gate messages
- Gates bypass when `--scope` or `--cluster` specified

### Synthesis (to become individual queue items)
- Currently ONE item: `synthesis::pending` (kind="synthesis_needed")
- Has 4 hidden stages: observe → reflect → organize → commit
- Stage progress tracked in `plan.epic_synthesis_meta.synthesis_stages` dict
- Each stage has: report, confirmed_at, confirmed_text, finding_count, cited_ids, timestamp
- Stage dependencies: observe→reflect→organize→commit (linear)
- Validation per stage: min char counts, citations, cluster enrichment checks
- Cascade clear: re-recording earlier stage clears later confirmations
- Completion removes synthesis::pending from queue, archives to last_synthesis
- Injected by `sync_synthesis_needed()` when review finding snapshot hash changes
- Build helper: `build_synthesis_item()` in helpers.py

### Synthesis Playbook (labels & commands)
```python
SYNTHESIS_STAGE_LABELS = (
    ("observe", "Analyse findings & spot contradictions"),
    ("reflect", "Form strategy & present to user"),
    ("organize", "Defer contradictions, cluster, & prioritize"),
    ("commit", "Write strategy & confirm"),
)
SYNTHESIS_STAGE_DEPENDENCIES = {
    "observe": set(),
    "reflect": {"observe"},
    "organize": {"reflect"},
    "commit": {"organize"},
}
```

### Review Items (already partial queue items)
- Created by `build_subjective_items()` in helpers.py
- Kind: "subjective_dimension", ID: `subjective::<slug>`
- Flags: initial_review, stale_review, backlog_gated
- Currently GATED by `_derive_gate_phase()` — only review items shown when gate active
- Sync functions: `sync_unscored_dimensions()` (front of queue), `sync_stale_dimensions()` (back of queue)
- primary_command: `desloppify review --prepare [--force-review-rerun]`

### Plan Gate Item (implicit, to become explicit)
- No actual queue item exists — just `pending_plan_gate` boolean on plan
- Cleared when user runs `desloppify plan` (in `_cmd_plan_generate()`)
- Blocks queue entirely with "needs_plan" gate phase

### Queue Item Lifecycle
- Items are ephemeral — regenerated each `build_work_queue()` call from state + plan
- Sort key: `item_sort_key()` returns tuple: (tier, subtype, confidence/score, id)
  - synthesis: (-1, 0, 0, id)
  - cluster: (0, action_priority, -count, id)  
  - subjective: (1, 1, score, id)
  - finding: (1, 0, confidence, -weight, -count, id)
- Plan ordering: `_apply_plan_order()` puts queue_order items first, then remaining
- WorkQueueResult has: items, total, grouped, suppressed_count, gate_phase, plan_dirty, new_ids

### Key Constants
- `SYNTHESIS_ID = "synthesis::pending"` in stale_dimensions.py
- `SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX = "subjective::"` in stale_dimensions.py

## Design Goals

1. **Eliminate gate phases entirely** — no more needs_review/needs_plan walls
2. **Synthesis stages become 4 individual queue items**: synthesis::observe, synthesis::reflect, synthesis::organize, synthesis::commit
3. **Plan creation becomes a queue item**: workflow::create-plan
4. **Review dimensions remain individual items** but lose their gate behavior (just sort high)
5. **One loop**: `next` → do → resolve → `next` for ALL item kinds
6. **Users can see everything**: `show`, `status`, `plan` display all items regardless of kind
7. **Users can reorder/skip anything**: `plan move`, `plan skip` work on workflow/synthesis items
8. **Backward compatible commands**: existing commands like `plan synthesize --stage observe` still work; they just also auto-resolve the corresponding queue item

## Key Design Questions to Address

1. **Synthesis stage dependencies**: How to handle observe→reflect→organize→commit ordering in the queue? Options:
   a) Inject all 4 upfront, but `next` skips blocked ones (shows them grayed out in `show`)
   b) Inject one at a time — when observe completes, inject reflect
   c) Inject all 4, use a `blocked_by` field, blocked items hidden from `next` but visible in `show`

2. **Auto-resolution**: When should queue items auto-resolve?
   - Review items: when review import covers that dimension
   - Plan creation item: when user runs `plan` command  
   - Synthesis stages: when stage report is submitted
   - Should auto-resolution happen in reconciliation or in the command handler?

3. **Tier assignments for new item types**:
   - Workflow items (create-plan): what tier?
   - Synthesis stages: what tier?
   - Review items: what tier? (currently gated, not tiered)

4. **The `pending_plan_gate` boolean**: Can it be fully replaced by the workflow::create-plan item?

5. **Synthesis meta storage**: Currently synthesis stage data lives in `epic_synthesis_meta.synthesis_stages`. Should this change or stay?

6. **New ID scheme**: 
   - Currently: `synthesis::pending` (one ID)
   - Proposed: `synthesis::observe`, `synthesis::reflect`, `synthesis::organize`, `synthesis::commit`
   - `workflow::create-plan`

7. **What "completing" a synthesis stage means in queue terms**: Currently it's stored in meta. In the new model, should the stage ID be removed from queue_order? Or marked in a new structure?

8. **Rendering**: How should `next` render workflow/synthesis items differently from findings?

9. **Inner synthesis flow**: The synthesis stages have complex validation (min chars, citations, cluster enrichment). How does this map? The `primary_command` points to the same `plan synthesize --stage X` commands. The stage handler validates and completes. The queue item auto-resolves when the stage handler succeeds.

Please design a comprehensive, concrete implementation plan addressing all of these. Be specific about which files change, what functions are added/modified/removed, and the migration path. Consider edge cases and backward compatibility.

   190→    ordered_ids: set[str] = set()
   191→    for fid in queue_order:
   192→        if fid in by_id and fid not in skipped_ids:
   193→            ordered.append(by_id[fid])
   194→            ordered_ids.add(fid)
   195→
   196→    skipped_items: list[dict] = []
   197→    remaining_existing: list[dict] = []
   198→    remaining_new: list[dict] = []
   199→    _new = new_ids or set()
   200→    for item in items:
   201→        item_id = item["id"]
   202→        if item_id in ordered_ids:
   203→            continue
   204→        if item_id in skipped_ids:
   205→            skipped_items.append(item)
   206→        elif item_id in _new:
   207→            remaining_new.append(item)
   208→        else:
   209→            remaining_existing.append(item)
   210→
   211→    # Assign queue positions — new items after existing ones
   212→    result = ordered + remaining_existing + remaining_new
   213→    if include_skipped:
   214→        result = result + skipped_items
   215→
   216→    for pos, item in enumerate(result):
   217→        item["queue_position"] = pos + 1
   218→        if item["id"] in skipped_ids:
   219→            item["plan_skipped"] = True
   220→            skip_entry = skipped_map.get(item["id"])
   221→            if skip_entry:
   222→                item["plan_skip_kind"] = skip_entry.get("kind", "temporary")
   223→                skip_reason = skip_entry.get("reason")
   224→                if skip_reason:
   225→                    item["plan_skip_reason"] = skip_reason
   226→
   227→    # Filter to cluster if requested
   228→    effective_cluster = cluster or active_cluster
   229→    if effective_cluster:
   230→        cluster_data = clusters.get(effective_cluster, {})
   231→        cluster_member_ids = set(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []))
   232→        if cluster_member_ids:
   233→            result = [item for item in result if item["id"] in cluster_member_ids]
   234→
   235→    return result
   236→
   237→
   238→def _action_type_for_detector(detector: str) -> str:
   239→    """Look up the action_type for a detector from the registry."""
   240→    try:
   241→        from desloppify.core.registry import DETECTORS
   242→        meta = DETECTORS.get(detector)
   243→        if meta:
   244→            return meta.action_type
   245→    except ImportError as exc:
   246→        _ = exc
   247→    return "manual_fix"
   248→
   249→
   250→def _collapse_clusters(items: list[dict], plan: dict) -> list[dict]:
   251→    """Replace cluster member items with single cluster meta-items."""
   252→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   253→    if not clusters:
   254→        return items
   255→
   256→    # Build mapping: finding_id → auto-cluster name
   257→    fid_to_cluster: dict[str, str] = {}
   258→    for name, cluster in clusters.items():
   259→        if not cluster.get("auto"):
   260→            continue
   261→        for fid in cluster.get("finding_ids", []):
   262→            fid_to_cluster[fid] = name
   263→
   264→    if not fid_to_cluster:
   265→        return items
   266→
   267→    # Collect members for each cluster, preserving order
   268→    cluster_members: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
   269→    non_cluster_items: list[dict] = []
   270→
   271→    for item in items:
   272→        cname = fid_to_cluster.get(item.get("id", ""))
   273→        if cname:
   274→            cluster_members.setdefault(cname, []).append(item)
   275→        else:
   276→            non_cluster_items.append(item)
   277→
   278→    # Build cluster meta-items
   279→    result: list[dict] = list(non_cluster_items)
   280→    for cname, members in cluster_members.items():
   281→        # Don't collapse singletons — show them as individual findings
   282→        if len(members) < 2:
   283→            result.extend(members)
   284→            continue
   285→        cluster_data = clusters.get(cname, {})
   286→        detector = members[0].get("detector", "") if members else ""
   287→        action = cluster_data.get("action") or ""
   288→        # Derive action_type from the actual cluster action, not just the detector
   289→        if "desloppify fix" in action:
   290→            action_type = "auto_fix"
   291→        elif "desloppify move" in action:
   292→            action_type = "reorganize"
   293→        else:
   294→            action_type = _action_type_for_detector(detector)
   295→            # If detector says auto_fix but cluster has no fix command, it's really refactor
   296→            if action_type == "auto_fix" and "desloppify fix" not in action:
   297→                action_type = "refactor"
   298→
   299→        # Use stored description but patch the count if it differs from visible members
   300→        stored_desc = cluster_data.get("description") or ""
   301→        total_in_cluster = len(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []))
   302→        if stored_desc and total_in_cluster != len(members):
   303→            # Replace the stored count with the visible count
   304→            summary = stored_desc.replace(str(total_in_cluster), str(len(members)))
   305→        else:
   306→            summary = stored_desc or f"{len(members)} findings"
   307→
   308→        primary_command = cluster_data.get("action")
   309→        if not primary_command:
   310→            primary_command = f"desloppify next --cluster {cname} --count 10"
   311→
   312→        meta_item: dict = {
   313→            "id": cname,
   314→            "kind": "cluster",
   315→            "action_type": action_type,
   316→            "summary": summary,
   317→            "members": members,
   318→            "member_count": len(members),
   319→            "primary_command": primary_command,
   320→            "cluster_name": cname,
   321→            "cluster_auto": True,
   322→            "cluster_optional": bool(cluster_data.get("optional")),
   323→            "confidence": "high",
   324→            "detector": detector,
   325→            "file": "",
   326→        }
   327→        result.append(meta_item)
   328→
   329→    result.sort(key=item_sort_key)
   330→    return result
   331→
   332→
   333→def build_work_queue(
   334→    state: StateModel,
   335→    *,
   336→    options: QueueBuildOptions | None = None,
   337→) -> WorkQueueResult:
   338→    """Build ranked queue items + tier metadata."""
   339→    resolved_options = options or QueueBuildOptions()
   340→
   341→    status = resolved_options.status
   342→    if status not in ALL_STATUSES:
   343→        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported status filter: {status}")
   344→    try:
   345→        subjective_threshold_value = float(resolved_options.subjective_threshold)
   346→    except (TypeError, ValueError):
   347→        subjective_threshold_value = 100.0
   348→    subjective_threshold_value = max(0.0, min(100.0, subjective_threshold_value))
   349→
   350→    finding_items = build_finding_items(
   351→        state,
   352→        scan_path=resolved_options.scan_path,
   353→        status_filter=status,
   354→        scope=resolved_options.scope,
   355→        chronic=resolved_options.chronic,
   356→    )
   357→
   358→    all_items = list(finding_items)
   359→    has_objective_backlog = bool(finding_items)
   360→    suppressed_count = 0
   361→    if (
   362→        resolved_options.include_subjective
   363→        and status in {"open", "all"}
   364→        and not resolved_options.chronic
   365→    ):
   366→        subjective_items = build_subjective_items(
   367→            state,
   368→            state.get("findings", {}),
   369→            threshold=subjective_threshold_value,
   370→        )
   371→        for item in subjective_items:
   372→            if not scope_matches(item, resolved_options.scope):
   373→                continue
   374→            # Suppress subjective items whose only action is a review rerun
   375→            # (--force-review-rerun) while objective backlog exists — the
   376→            # review preflight blocks reruns until the backlog drains.
   377→            if has_objective_backlog and item.get("backlog_gated"):
   378→                suppressed_count += 1
   379→                continue
   380→            all_items.append(item)
   381→
   382→    # Inject synthesis::pending synthetic item when plan requires it
   383→    if resolved_options.plan and status in {"open", "all"}:
   384→        synth_item = build_synthesis_item(resolved_options.plan, state)
   385→        if synth_item is not None:
   386→            all_items.append(synth_item)
   387→
   388→    all_items.sort(key=item_sort_key)
   389→
   390→    # Apply living plan ordering if provided
   391→    new_ids: set[str] = set()
   392→    if resolved_options.plan:
   393→        new_ids = _new_item_ids(state)
   394→        all_items = _apply_plan_order(
   395→            all_items,
   396→            resolved_options.plan,
   397→            include_skipped=resolved_options.include_skipped,
   398→            cluster=resolved_options.cluster,
   399→            new_ids=new_ids,
   400→        )
   401→
   402→    # Collapse auto-clusters into meta-items (unless drilling into a cluster)
   403→    should_collapse = (
   404→        resolved_options.collapse_clusters
   405→        and resolved_options.plan
   406→        and not resolved_options.cluster
   407→        and not resolved_options.plan.get("active_cluster")
   408→    )
   409→    if should_collapse:
   410→        all_items = _collapse_clusters(all_items, resolved_options.plan)
   411→
   412→    # --- Phase gate: filter queue when in a review/plan cycle ---------------
   413→    gate_bypass = bool(resolved_options.scope or resolved_options.cluster)
   414→    gate_phase: str | None = None
   415→    plan_dirty = False
   416→    if not gate_bypass:
   417→        gate_phase, all_items, plan_dirty = _derive_gate_phase(
   418→            all_items,
   419→            resolved_options.plan,
   420→            has_objective_findings=bool(finding_items),
   421→        )
   422→
   423→    should_interleave = (
   424→        resolved_options.include_subjective
   425→        and status in {"open", "all"}
   426→        and not resolved_options.chronic
   427→        and not resolved_options.scope
   428→        and not resolved_options.cluster
   429→    )
   430→    if should_interleave:
   431→        all_items = _apply_subjective_interleave_guardrail(all_items)
   432→
   433→    total = len(all_items)
   434→    if resolved_options.count is not None and resolved_options.count > 0:
   435→        all_items = all_items[: resolved_options.count]
   436→
   437→    if resolved_options.explain:
   438→        for item in all_items:
   439→            item["explain"] = item_explain(item)
   440→
   441→    return {
   442→        "items": all_items,
   443→        "total": total,
   444→        "grouped": group_queue_items(all_items, "item"),
   445→        "new_ids": new_ids,
   446→        "suppressed_count": suppressed_count,
   447→        "gate_phase": gate_phase,
   448→        "plan_dirty": plan_dirty,
   449→    }
   450→
   451→
   452→__all__ = [
   453→    "ATTEST_EXAMPLE",
   454→    "QueueBuildOptions",
   455→    "WorkQueueResult",
   456→    "build_work_queue",
   457→    "group_queue_items",
   458→]
   459→

   310→    for finding in findings.values():
   311→        if finding.get("status") != "open" or finding.get("detector") != "review":
   312→            continue
   313→        dim_key = str(detail_dict(finding).get("dimension", "")).strip().lower()
   314→        if not dim_key:
   315→            continue
   316→        review_open_by_dim[dim_key] = review_open_by_dim.get(dim_key, 0) + 1
   317→
   318→    items: list[dict] = []
   319→    def _prepare_command(
   320→        cli_keys: list[str],
   321→        *,
   322→        force_review_rerun: bool = False,
   323→    ) -> str:
   324→        command = "desloppify review --prepare"
   325→        if cli_keys:
   326→            command += " --dimensions " + ",".join(cli_keys)
   327→        if force_review_rerun:
   328→            command += " --force-review-rerun"
   329→        return command
   330→
   331→    for entry in subjective_entries:
   332→        name = str(entry.get("name", "")).strip()
   333→        if not name:
   334→            continue
   335→        strict_val = float(entry.get("strict", entry.get("score", 100.0)))
   336→        if strict_val >= threshold:
   337→            continue
   338→
   339→        [REDACTED](name)
   340→        aliases = set(_subjective_dimension_aliases(name))
   341→        cli_keys = [
   342→            str(key).strip().lower()
   343→            for key in entry.get("cli_keys", [])
   344→            if str(key).strip()
   345→        ]
   346→        aliases.update(cli_keys)
   347→        aliases.update(slugify(key) for key in cli_keys)
   348→        open_review = sum(review_open_by_dim.get(alias, 0) for alias in aliases)
   349→        is_unassessed = bool(entry.get("placeholder")) or (
   350→            name in unassessed_dims
   351→            or (strict_val <= 0.0 and int(entry.get("issues", 0)) == 0)
   352→        )
   353→        is_stale = bool(entry.get("stale"))
   354→        # Items whose only action is --force-review-rerun are gated by the
   355→        # review preflight while objective backlog exists.  Flag them so the
   356→        # queue builder can suppress them until the backlog drains.
   357→        is_backlog_gated = open_review == 0 and not is_unassessed
   358→        # If review findings already exist for this dimension, triage/fix them
   359→        # before suggesting another review refresh pass.
   360→        if open_review > 0:
   361→            primary_command = "desloppify show review --status open"
   362→        elif is_unassessed:
   363→            primary_command = _prepare_command(cli_keys)
   364→        elif is_stale:
   365→            primary_command = _prepare_command(
   366→                cli_keys,
   367→                force_review_rerun=True,
   368→            )
   369→        elif cli_keys:
   370→            primary_command = _prepare_command(
   371→                cli_keys,
   372→                force_review_rerun=True,
   373→            )
   374→        else:
   375→            primary_command = _prepare_command(
   376→                cli_keys,
   377→                force_review_rerun=True,
   378→            )
   379→        stale_tag = " [stale — re-review]" if is_stale else ""
   380→        summary = f"Subjective dimension below target: {name} ({strict_val:.1f}%){stale_tag}"
   381→        items.append(
   382→            {
   383→                "id": f"subjective::{slugify(dim_key)}",
   384→                "detector": "subjective_assessment",
   385→                "file": ".",
   386→                "confidence": "medium",
   387→                "summary": summary,
   388→                "detail": {
   389→                    "dimension_name": name,
   390→                    "dimension": dim_key,
   391→                    "issues": int(entry.get("issues", 0)),
   392→                    "strict_score": strict_val,
   393→                    "open_review_findings": open_review,
   394→                    "cli_keys": cli_keys,
   395→                },
   396→                "status": "open",
   397→                "kind": "subjective_dimension",
   398→                "primary_command": primary_command,
   399→                "backlog_gated": is_backlog_gated,
   400→                "initial_review": is_unassessed,
   401→                "stale_review": is_stale and not is_unassessed,
   402→            }
   403→        )
   404→    return items
   405→

    22→def subjective_score_value(item: dict) -> float:
    23→    if item.get("kind") == "subjective_dimension":
    24→        detail = detail_dict(item)

    29→def build_finding_items(
    30→    state: dict,
    31→    *,
    32→    scan_path: str | None,
    33→    status_filter: str,
    34→    scope: str | None,
    35→    chronic: bool,
    36→) -> list[dict]:
    37→    scoped = path_scoped_findings(state.get("findings", {}), scan_path)
    38→    subjective_scores = subjective_strict_scores(state)
    39→    out: list[dict] = []
    40→
    41→    for finding_id, finding in scoped.items():
    42→        if finding.get("suppressed"):
    43→            continue
    44→        if not status_matches(finding.get("status", "open"), status_filter):
    45→            continue
    46→        if chronic and not (
    47→            finding.get("status") == "open" and finding.get("reopen_count", 0) >= 2
    48→        ):
    49→            continue
    50→
    51→        item = dict(finding)
    52→        item["id"] = finding_id
    53→        item["kind"] = "finding"
    54→        item["is_review"] = is_review_finding(item)
    55→        item["is_subjective"] = is_subjective_finding(item)
    56→        item["review_weight"] = (
    57→            review_finding_weight(item) if item["is_review"] else None
    58→        )
    59→        subjective_score = None
    60→        if item["is_subjective"]:
    61→            detail = detail_dict(finding)
    62→            dim_name = detail.get("dimension_name", "")
    63→            dim_key = detail.get("dimension", "") or slugify(dim_name)
    64→            subjective_score = subjective_scores.get(
    65→                dim_key, subjective_scores.get(dim_name.lower(), 100.0)
    66→            )
    67→        item["subjective_score"] = subjective_score
    68→        supported_fixers = supported_fixers_for_item(state, item)
    69→        item["primary_command"] = primary_command_for_finding(

    81→def item_sort_key(item: dict) -> tuple:
    82→    if item.get("kind") == "synthesis_needed":
    83→        # Synthesis items always sort first — they block all other work.
    84→        return (-1, 0, 0, item.get("id", ""))
    85→
    86→    if item.get("kind") == "cluster":
    87→        # Clusters sort before individual findings, ordered by action type
    88→        # (auto_fix first, then reorganize, refactor, manual_fix),

    90→        action_pri = ACTION_TYPE_PRIORITY.get(

    94→            0,  # All clusters before all individual findings
    95→            action_pri,
    96→            -int(item.get("member_count", 0)),
    97→            item.get("id", ""),
    98→        )

   100→    if item.get("kind") == "subjective_dimension" or item.get("is_subjective"):

   110→    return (

   114→        -review_weight,
   115→        -int(detail.get("count", 0) or 0),
   116→        item.get("id", ""),
   117→    )
   118→
   119→
   120→def item_explain(item: dict) -> dict:
   121→    if item.get("kind") == "subjective_dimension":
   122→        return {
   123→            "kind": "subjective_dimension",
   124→            "subjective_score": subjective_score_value(item),
   125→            "policy": (
   126→                "Subjective dimensions sort after mechanical items at the same level."
   127→            ),
   128→            "ranking_factors": ["subjective_score asc", "id asc"],
   129→        }
   130→
   131→    detail = detail_dict(item)
   132→    confidence = item.get("confidence", "low")
   133→    is_subjective = bool(item.get("is_subjective"))
   134→    is_review = bool(item.get("is_review"))
   135→    ranking_factors: list[str]
   136→    if is_subjective:
   137→        ranking_factors = ["subjective_score asc", "id asc"]
   138→    elif is_review:
   139→        ranking_factors = [
   140→            "confidence asc",
   141→            "review_weight desc",
   142→            "count desc",
   143→            "id asc",
   144→        ]
   145→    else:
   146→        ranking_factors = ["confidence asc", "count desc", "id asc"]
   147→    explain = {
   148→        "kind": "finding",
   149→        "confidence": confidence,
   150→        "confidence_rank": CONFIDENCE_ORDER.get(confidence, 9),
   151→        "count": int(detail.get("count", 0) or 0),
   152→        "id": item.get("id", ""),
   153→        "ranking_factors": ranking_factors,
   154→    }
   155→    if is_review:
   156→        explain["review_weight"] = float(item.get("review_weight", 0.0) or 0.0)
   157→    if is_subjective:
   158→        explain["policy"] = (
   159→            "Subjective findings sort after mechanical items at the same level."
   160→        )
   161→        explain["subjective_score"] = subjective_score_value(item)
   162→    return explain

   165→def group_queue_items(items: list[dict], group: str) -> dict[str, list[dict]]:
   166→    """Group queue items for alternate output modes."""
   167→    grouped: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
   168→    for item in items:
   169→        if group == "file":
   170→            key = item.get("file", "")
   171→        elif group == "detector":
   172→            key = item.get("detector", "")
   173→        elif group == "cluster":
   174→            plan_cluster = item.get("plan_cluster")
   175→            key = plan_cluster["name"] if isinstance(plan_cluster, dict) else "(unclustered)"
   176→        else:
   177→            key = "items"
   178→        grouped.setdefault(key, []).append(item)
   179→    return grouped
   180→

   114→def _ensure_container_types(plan: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
   115→    if not isinstance(plan.get("queue_order"), list):
   116→        plan["queue_order"] = []
   117→    if not isinstance(plan.get("deferred"), list):
   118→        plan["deferred"] = []
   119→    if not isinstance(plan.get("skipped"), dict):
   120→        plan["skipped"] = {}
   121→    if not isinstance(plan.get("overrides"), dict):
   122→        plan["overrides"] = {}
   123→    if not isinstance(plan.get("clusters"), dict):
   124→        plan["clusters"] = {}
   125→    if not isinstance(plan.get("superseded"), dict):
   126→        plan["superseded"] = {}
   127→    if not isinstance(plan.get("promoted_ids"), list):
   128→        plan["promoted_ids"] = []
   129→    if not isinstance(plan.get("plan_start_scores"), dict):
   130→        plan["plan_start_scores"] = {}
   131→    if not isinstance(plan.get("execution_log"), list):
   132→        plan["execution_log"] = []
   133→    if not isinstance(plan.get("epic_synthesis_meta"), dict):
   134→        plan["epic_synthesis_meta"] = {}
   135→    if not isinstance(plan.get("pending_plan_gate"), bool):
   136→        plan["pending_plan_gate"] = False
